clause: Raw input scope + native deterministic sensor decode/demosaic [STU-RAW-003]

scope.summary: Implement the raw decode step in studio-engine: accept mosaic Bayer + X-Trans sensor inputs and demosaic through a native deterministic engine (RasterEngine/RenderEngine boundary), accept the documented DNG container, and route non-raw high-bit sources (TIFF/JPEG) through the same develop surface so develop adjustments act as a re-editable filter on non-raw layers. Support inputs to the document raster ceiling; the decode boundary is the API decode step per [STU-DOC-003]; color carries an explicit StudioColorProfile from decode onward with no implicit device color.
acceptance_criteria: Bayer/X-Trans + DNG + non-raw high-bit decode deterministic; explicit color from decode
expected_tests: test: Bayer + X-Trans demosaic deterministic under fixed process version
test: DNG + TIFF/JPEG route into same develop surface as re-editable filter
test: StudioColorProfile explicit from decode (no implicit device color)

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Headless/backend MT: no operator-visible surface changed.

user_manual_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Non-product-behavior or internal-scaffold MT; UserManual updated by the consuming feature MT.

risk_if_missed: No sensor decode; nothing to develop; implicit device color corrupts pipeline.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
SQLite creep on a studio_* write path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
